name: Centralized Conics Approach
aliases: Botsch et al. Splat Extent Approximation
Zwicker et al. Centralized Conics Approach
definition: A method to compute screen-space position and extents involving the inverse of a 2D-to-2D projective mapping from the splat's parameter space to screen-space.
summary: The Centralized Conics Approach efficiently approximates splat extents by inverting a projective mapping, prioritizing speed over geometric exactness.
